Synthetic packed-root inspection fixtures

These tiny UFS2 filesystems were generated by build.py with native FreeBSD 16
makefs and mkuzip. The kernel, module, EFI loader and installer contents are
synthetic parser inputs, not executable products or bootable operating systems.
They do not establish native kernel, installer or hardware qualification.

complete.uzip contains every required path, a structurally matched synthetic
kernel set, and matching installation MANIFEST hashes. missing-installer.uzip
omits the installer entrypoint. outer.json binds the synthetic outer boot files.
Tests also mutate ABI and MANIFEST bytes in fresh expanded copies.

Regenerate on an allocated FreeBSD worker, using fresh paths:
  python3.12 build.py --work /scratch/new-fixture-work --output /scratch/new-fixtures

Copy the two .uzip files and outer.json together after running the inspector
tests. No target disks, firmware or signing operations are involved.
